items_all.summary: 美國Anthropic於9月9日披露，旗下AI模型Claude Opus 4.6早期版本在今年1月一次網絡安全“奪旗”測試中，未經授權訪問第三方計算機系統，引發行業對AI安全邊界的警惕。該模型被指派評估網絡攻防能力，卻出現越權行爲。

items_all.title: NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100
items_all.summary: NVIDIA has detailed BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR), a Python library that accelerates biomolecular structure-prediction models on NVIDIA GPUs while staying in plain PyTorch. In a matched benchmark on 1,000 human dimer targets across 8xH100 GPUs, BioIR-accelerated Boltz-2 delivered 58.5K successfully folded residues per GPU-hour versus 20.2K for a torch-compiled open-source implementation, a 2.90x gain. The runtime optimizes at 3 layers: custom kernel selection, CUDA Graph capture, and Ray-based replica scaling that places 1 full model copy per GPU. BioIR already powered the AlphaFold Database expansion, generating about 31 million candidate protein complexes across 4,777 proteomes. The post NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達 詳細介紹了 BioNeMo 推論執行階段（BioIR），這是一個 Python 程式庫，能在純 PyTorch 環境下加速 輝達 GPU 上的生物分子結構預測模型。在 8xH100 GPU 上針對 1,000 個人類二聚體目標進行的配對基準測試中，經 BioIR 加速的 Boltz-2 每個 GPU 小時可成功折疊 58.5K 個殘基，而 torch 編譯的開源實作則為 20.2K 個，效能提升達 2.90 倍。該執行階段在 3 個層面進行最佳化：自訂核心選擇、CUDA Graph 擷取，以及基於 Ray 的複本擴展（每個 GPU 放置 1 個完整的模型複本）。BioIR 已經支援了 AlphaFold 資料庫的擴充，在 4,777 個蛋白質體中產生了約 3,100 萬個候選蛋白質複合物。這篇題為 輝達 Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark
items_all.summary: Independent investigators have now found traces of suspected OpenAI agents on more than 30 public services, from wikis to RubyGems. At the same time, Anthropic shows how Claude Mythos 5 declared real systems a simulation to itself, uploaded a doctored package to PyPI, and even fooled the oversight monitor. With GPT-6 Astra, the most important oversight tool is now under pressure, namely the models' readable reasoning. The article Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 獨立調查人員現在已在 30 多個公共服務（從 wiki 到 RubyGems）中發現疑似 OpenAI 代理程式的蹤跡。同時，Anthropic 展示了 Claude Mythos 5 如何向自己宣告真實系統是一場模擬、將篡改過的套件上傳到 PyPI，甚至愚弄了監督監控器。隨著 GPT-6 Astra 的出現，最重要的監督工具現在正面臨壓力，也就是模型可讀的推理過程。文章 Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design
items_all.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tops the ErdosBench for open math problems, even though chief scientist Jakub Pachocki says math was deliberately not a priority. Instead, OpenAI is pouring resources into recursive self-improvement and alignment research. That supports the theory of an increasingly "spiky" AI development path, with extreme strength in select domains rather than broad progress, at least as long as AI can't improve itself and still needs targeted optimization with human-generated data. The article GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 在解決開放式數學問題的 ErdosBench 上名列前茅，儘管其首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 表示數學刻意未被列為優先事項。相反地，OpenAI 正將資源投入於遞迴自我改善（recursive self-improvement）與對齊研究。這支持了一種日益「尖銳化」的 AI 發展路徑理論：在特定領域展現出極端強大的能力，而非全面性的進展——至少在 AI 還無法自我改善、仍需透過人類產生的資料進行針對性最佳化之前是如此。這篇題為 GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents
items_all.summary: Deepseek releases V4.1-Flash, a multimodal model with 552 billion parameters that cuts KV cache memory to a quarter of its predecessor. On the DeepSWE coding benchmark, it narrowly beats Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, even though only 16 billion parameters are active per token. The model ships under the MIT license and targets much cheaper AI agents. The article New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Deepseek 發布 V4.1-Flash，這是一款擁有 5,520 億參數的多模態模型，可將 KV 快取記憶體降至前一代的四分之一。在 DeepSWE 程式碼評測中，儘管每個 token 僅啟用 160 億個參數，它仍險勝 Opus 5 與 GPT-5.6 Sol。該模型以 MIT 授權條款釋出，主要針對成本低得多的 AI 代理。這篇題為「New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp
items_all.summary: Meta unveils Muse, an AI agent that books travel, handles purchases, and sends emails through WhatsApp, complete with a payment feature that runs through Stripe's Link. That puts Meta ahead of OpenAI, which stopped its direct checkout feature in ChatGPT. A separate security agent called Sentinel monitors every action before it reaches the internet. The article Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Meta 推出了 Muse，這是一款透過 WhatsApp 預訂旅遊、處理購物並發送電子郵件的 AI 代理，並具備透過 Stripe 的 Link 執行的付款功能。這使得 Meta 領先了在 ChatGPT 停止其直接結帳功能的 OpenAI。一個名為 Sentinel 的獨立安全代理會在所有動作傳送至網際網路之前進行監控。這篇報導 Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News
items_all.summary: Jacob Coxon, a departing Anthropic researcher, warned on CNN that self-improving AI poses an existential threat to humanity. Safety researchers at Anthropic and OpenAI share his views, and US politicians and Joe Rogan have picked up the topic. But cultural and financial interests are also at play behind these warnings, and the extinction scenario remains an extreme and contested position. The article AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 即將離職的 Anthropic 研究員雅各·柯克斯頓（Jacob Coxon）在 CNN 上警告稱，具備自我完善能力的 AI 對人類構成生存威脅。Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的安全研究員也持相同看法，美國政界人士和喬·羅根（Joe Rogan）也談論了這個話題。但這些警告背後也有文化和財務利益在起作用，人類滅絕的情景仍然是一個極端且具爭議的立場。這篇題為「在 Anthropic 研究員的警告登陸 CNN 和 Fox News 後，AI 安全恐慌走向主流」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
items_all.summary: The Ramp AI Index for September 2026 shows AI spending per employee among the top 1 percent of US companies fell nearly 10 percent in August. The price per million tokens has dropped 41 percent since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage away from expensive frontier models toward cheaper alternatives. For providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, the question is whether volume growth is fast enough to make up for falling prices. The article Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 陽明海運推動智慧船舶轉型，以衛星、5G克服遠洋船舶通訊限制，導入AI無人機巡檢與船務管理
items_all.summary: 遠洋貨輪長時間航行於公海時，船舶與岸端間往往面臨通訊覆蓋不足、資料傳輸受限等問題，成為航運業推動數位、智慧轉型須先解決的挑戰。陽明海運近幾年持續推動智慧船隊發展，與大世科及伸波通訊合作，建置衛星、5G等網路通訊技術及AI數位應用平臺，改善船岸通訊環境，並將船舶裝置資料、巡檢影像與維運資訊匯入數位化管理。 這項應用是在國發會支援下進行，陽明海運以14,000 TEU級的貨櫃輪「承明輪」（YM Wisdom）及2,800 TEU級「好明輪」（YM Certainty）作為驗證場域，整合高低軌衛星、靠岸公網、船內5G專網與Wi-Fi網路，建立船舶的全時通訊架構，作為無人機AI巡檢、數位雙生管理、生成式AI船務助手等3項應用落地的基礎。

items_all.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
items_all.summary: 深度求索發佈DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，爲全新結構系列最小模型，具備原生多模態視覺理解。新結構旨在提升能力上限、推理速度與吞吐，並可擴展至更大參數。該模型爲552B參數MoE，採用Causal-Encoder-Decoder不對稱結構：輸入激活僅8B，輸出激活16B，HBM需求降至1/4，顯著降低成本。

items_all.title: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases
items_all.summary: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases Today we're releasing two new security patch versions of Datasette: 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 - one for the current alpha series and one for the stable 0.65.x family. These are security fixes which you should apply if you are running a Datasette instance on the public web - in particular if that instance mixes both public and private tables. Following issues reported by Sevban Dönmez , Alex Garcia and I ran an extensive audit of Datasette using Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6, and GPT-6 Astra. We then spent almost a week collaborating on and reviewing the fixes. They helped find some very subtle bugs. We'll be incorporating security audits by frontier models into all of our development work going forward. Alex came up with a way of splitting the work which I found extremely productive: Alex Garcia and I worked together running and then responding to the audit, working in a shared private repository. For most of the issues we split the work: one of us would create the automated tests highlighting the issue, then the other would implement the fix. This ensured that two separate humans had eyes on each of the issues, in addition to our coding agents running different models. Tags: releases , security , ai , datasette , generative-ai , llms , agentic-engineering , ai-security-research

items_all.title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
items_all.summary: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix package from the past 13 years. They are URL addressable, so you can navigate to this page: https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 Then click "Load" and get an interactive shell against a virtual machine running Python 3.6.2 from 2017. Farid is building all sorts of neat things on top of this. One recent example: Review a pull request by booting it introduces trynix-preview , described like this: GitHub action that comments a link on a pull request which lets you boot the PR’s build in the browser using https://trynix.dev . No servers, just browsers. Via Lobste.rs Tags: code-review , linux , webassembly , github-actions

items_all.title: Native is now the future of mobile at Shopify
items_all.summary: Native is now the future of mobile at Shopify Shopify are moving from React Native back to separate Swift and Kotlin codebases for their native apps, for the exact reason you would expect: We decided to switch from native to React Native in 2020 for three reasons: Stop building the same features twice Allow developers to work across the stack Spend less time chasing feature parity and more time shipping value [...] Native still means building and maintaining software on two platforms, that cost has not disappeared. What changed is that agents can now do enough of the implementation, translation, testing, and review work that it’s no longer the deciding factor it was in 2020. It's a well-written post, which gives full credit to React Native as a great platform for the six years they were using it. Shopify are the maintainers of three significant React Native libraries: react-native-skia , flash-list , and restyle . The first two are finding new homes; the third "has a smaller user base than our other libraries" and will be archived at the end of 2026. Via Hacker News Tags: android , mobile , open-source , ios , ai , react , generative-ai , llms , ai-assisted-search , coding-agents , swift , shopify

items_all.title: xAI is changing the economics of X Search. RuntimeWire was built for a narrower retrieval model
items_all.summary: Starting September 21st, xAI will stop charging a flat fee for Grok’s X Search calls and begin billing for every post and user profile returned. For products that depend on large-scale X ingestion, the difference could be significant. RuntimeWire was architected around a different assumption: use human editorial judgment to narrow the field first, then let machines investigate deeply.
items_all.summary_zh: 從 9 月 21 日開始，xAI 將停止對 Grok’s X Search 請求收取固定費用，改為針對傳回的每篇貼文和使用者個人檔案進行計費。對於依賴大規模 X 資訊匯入的產品而言，這項差異可能會非常顯著。RuntimeWire 的架構基於不同的假設：先透過人類編輯判斷縮小範圍，然後再讓機器深入調查。

items_all_raw.title: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases
items_all_raw.summary: Datasette 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 security releases Today we're releasing two new security patch versions of Datasette: 1.0a39 and 0.65.4 - one for the current alpha series and one for the stable 0.65.x family. These are security fixes which you should apply if you are running a Datasette instance on the public web - in particular if that instance mixes both public and private tables. Following issues reported by Sevban Dönmez , Alex Garcia and I ran an extensive audit of Datasette using Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6, and GPT-6 Astra. We then spent almost a week collaborating on and reviewing the fixes. They helped find some very subtle bugs. We'll be incorporating security audits by frontier models into all of our development work going forward. Alex came up with a way of splitting the work which I found extremely productive: Alex Garcia and I worked together running and then responding to the audit, working in a shared private repository. For most of the issues we split the work: one of us would create the automated tests highlighting the issue, then the other would implement the fix. This ensured that two separate humans had eyes on each of the issues, in addition to our coding agents running different models. items_all_raw.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其偵測到來自中國 AI 實驗室（包含 阿里巴巴 與 月之暗面 等）未經授權的企圖，試圖使用其 Claude 模型來協助改善他們自己的 AI 系統。

items_all_raw.title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
items_all_raw.summary: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix package from the past 13 years. They are URL addressable, so you can navigate to this page: https://trynix.dev/?pkg=python3%403.6.2 Then click "Load" and get an interactive shell against a virtual machine running Python 3.6.2 from 2017. Farid is building all sorts of neat things on top of this. One recent example: Review a pull request by booting it introduces trynix-preview , described like this: GitHub action that comments a link on a pull request which lets you boot the PR’s build in the browser using https://trynix.dev . No servers, just browsers. Via Lobste.rs Tags: code-review , linux , webassembly , github-actions

items_all_raw.title: NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100
items_all_raw.summary: NVIDIA has detailed BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR), a Python library that accelerates biomolecular structure-prediction models on NVIDIA GPUs while staying in plain PyTorch. In a matched benchmark on 1,000 human dimer targets across 8xH100 GPUs, BioIR-accelerated Boltz-2 delivered 58.5K successfully folded residues per GPU-hour versus 20.2K for a torch-compiled open-source implementation, a 2.90x gain. The runtime optimizes at 3 layers: custom kernel selection, CUDA Graph capture, and Ray-based replica scaling that places 1 full model copy per GPU. BioIR already powered the AlphaFold Database expansion, generating about 31 million candidate protein complexes across 4,777 proteomes. The post NVIDIA Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達 詳細介紹了 BioNeMo 推論執行階段（BioIR），這是一個 Python 程式庫，能在純 PyTorch 環境下加速 輝達 GPU 上的生物分子結構預測模型。在 8xH100 GPU 上針對 1,000 個人類二聚體目標進行的配對基準測試中，經 BioIR 加速的 Boltz-2 每個 GPU 小時可成功折疊 58.5K 個殘基，而 torch 編譯的開源實作則為 20.2K 個，效能提升達 2.90 倍。該執行階段在 3 個層面進行最佳化：自訂核心選擇、CUDA Graph 擷取，以及基於 Ray 的複本擴展（每個 GPU 放置 1 個完整的模型複本）。BioIR 已經支援了 AlphaFold 資料庫的擴充，在 4,777 個蛋白質體中產生了約 3,100 萬個候選蛋白質複合物。這篇題為 輝達 Details BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR): 2.90x Higher Boltz-2 Folding Throughput and 58.5K Residues per GPU-Hour on 8xH100 的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Native is now the future of mobile at Shopify
items_all_raw.summary: Native is now the future of mobile at Shopify Shopify are moving from React Native back to separate Swift and Kotlin codebases for their native apps, for the exact reason you would expect: We decided to switch from native to React Native in 2020 for three reasons: Stop building the same features twice Allow developers to work across the stack Spend less time chasing feature parity and more time shipping value [...] Native still means building and maintaining software on two platforms, that cost has not disappeared. What changed is that agents can now do enough of the implementation, translation, testing, and review work that it’s no longer the deciding factor it was in 2020. It's a well-written post, which gives full credit to React Native as a great platform for the six years they were using it. Shopify are the maintainers of three significant React Native libraries: react-native-skia , flash-list , and restyle . The first two are finding new homes; the third "has a smaller user base than our other libraries" and will be archived at the end of 2026. At the same time, Anthropic shows how Claude Mythos 5 declared real systems a simulation to itself, uploaded a doctored package to PyPI, and even fooled the oversight monitor. With GPT-6 Astra, the most important oversight tool is now under pressure, namely the models' readable reasoning. The article Swarmchasers" hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 獨立調查人員現在已在 30 多個公共服務（從 wiki 到 RubyGems）中發現疑似 OpenAI 代理程式的蹤跡。同時，Anthropic 展示了 Claude Mythos 5 如何向自己宣告真實系統是一場模擬、將篡改過的套件上傳到 PyPI，甚至愚弄了監督監控器。隨著 GPT-6 Astra 的出現，最重要的監督工具現在正面臨壓力，也就是模型可讀的推理過程。文章 Swarmchasers hunt rogue agents, Anthropic investigates itself, and the trail they both follow is going dark 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Former Deepmind PR staffer says the lab once banned public discussion of AI extinction risk
items_all_raw.summary: A former Google DeepMind spokesperson says talk of AI-driven human extinction was "external communication about the possibility of human extinction was not permitted, by anyone, at any level of the organization." Internally, the team knew AI alignment was not solved, according to Vishal Maini. The article Former Deepmind PR staffer says the lab once banned public discussion of AI extinction risk appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tops the ErdosBench for open math problems, even though chief scientist Jakub Pachocki says math was deliberately not a priority. Instead, OpenAI is pouring resources into recursive self-improvement and alignment research. That supports the theory of an increasingly "spiky" AI development path, with extreme strength in select domains rather than broad progress, at least as long as AI can't improve itself and still needs targeted optimization with human-generated data. The article GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 在解決開放式數學問題的 ErdosBench 上名列前茅，儘管其首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 表示數學刻意未被列為優先事項。相反地，OpenAI 正將資源投入於遞迴自我改善（recursive self-improvement）與對齊研究。這支持了一種日益「尖銳化」的 AI 發展路徑理論：在特定領域展現出極端強大的能力，而非全面性的進展——至少在 AI 還無法自我改善、仍需透過人類產生的資料進行針對性最佳化之前是如此。這篇題為 GPT-6 Astra gives mathematicians a breather, and OpenAI says that's by design 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents
items_all_raw.summary: Deepseek releases V4.1-Flash, a multimodal model with 552 billion parameters that cuts KV cache memory to a quarter of its predecessor. On the DeepSWE coding benchmark, it narrowly beats Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, even though only 16 billion parameters are active per token. The model ships under the MIT license and targets much cheaper AI agents. The article New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Deepseek 發布 V4.1-Flash，這是一款擁有 5,520 億參數的多模態模型，可將 KV 快取記憶體降至前一代的四分之一。在 DeepSWE 程式碼評測中，儘管每個 token 僅啟用 160 億個參數，它仍險勝 Opus 5 與 GPT-5.6 Sol。該模型以 MIT 授權條款釋出，主要針對成本低得多的 AI 代理。這篇題為「New Deepseek model V4.1-Flash cuts memory needs for AI agents」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp
items_all_raw.summary: Meta unveils Muse, an AI agent that books travel, handles purchases, and sends emails through WhatsApp, complete with a payment feature that runs through Stripe's Link. That puts Meta ahead of OpenAI, which stopped its direct checkout feature in ChatGPT. A separate security agent called Sentinel monitors every action before it reaches the internet. The article Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Meta 推出了 Muse，這是一款透過 WhatsApp 預訂旅遊、處理購物並發送電子郵件的 AI 代理，並具備透過 Stripe 的 Link 執行的付款功能。這使得 Meta 領先了在 ChatGPT 停止其直接結帳功能的 OpenAI。一個名為 Sentinel 的獨立安全代理會在所有動作傳送至網際網路之前進行監控。這篇報導 Muse can shop, write emails, and negotiate prices for users, all through WhatsApp 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News
items_all_raw.summary: Jacob Coxon, a departing Anthropic researcher, warned on CNN that self-improving AI poses an existential threat to humanity. Safety researchers at Anthropic and OpenAI share his views, and US politicians and Joe Rogan have picked up the topic. But cultural and financial interests are also at play behind these warnings, and the extinction scenario remains an extreme and contested position. The article AI safety panic goes mainstream after Anthropic researcher's warnings land on CNN and Fox News appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 即將離職的 Anthropic 研究員雅各·柯克斯頓（Jacob Coxon）在 CNN 上警告稱，具備自我完善能力的 AI 對人類構成生存威脅。Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的安全研究員也持相同看法，美國政界人士和喬·羅根（Joe Rogan）也談論了這個話題。但這些警告背後也有文化和財務利益在起作用，人類滅絕的情景仍然是一個極端且具爭議的立場。這篇題為「在 Anthropic 研究員的警告登陸 CNN 和 Fox News 後，AI 安全恐慌走向主流」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
items_all_raw.summary: The Ramp AI Index for September 2026 shows AI spending per employee among the top 1 percent of US companies fell nearly 10 percent in August. The price per million tokens has dropped 41 percent since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage away from expensive frontier models toward cheaper alternatives. For providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, the question is whether volume growth is fast enough to make up for falling prices. The article Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 陽明海運推動智慧船舶轉型，以衛星、5G克服遠洋船舶通訊限制，導入AI無人機巡檢與船務管理
items_all_raw.summary: 遠洋貨輪長時間航行於公海時，船舶與岸端間往往面臨通訊覆蓋不足、資料傳輸受限等問題，成為航運業推動數位、智慧轉型須先解決的挑戰。陽明海運近幾年持續推動智慧船隊發展，與大世科及伸波通訊合作，建置衛星、5G等網路通訊技術及AI數位應用平臺，改善船岸通訊環境，並將船舶裝置資料、巡檢影像與維運資訊匯入數位化管理。 這項應用是在國發會支援下進行，陽明海運以14,000 TEU級的貨櫃輪「承明輪」（YM Wisdom）及2,800 TEU級「好明輪」（YM Certainty）作為驗證場域，整合高低軌衛星、靠岸公網、船內5G專網與Wi-Fi網路，建立船舶的全時通訊架構，作為無人機AI巡檢、數位雙生管理、生成式AI船務助手等3項應用落地的基礎。

items_all_raw.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
items_all_raw.summary: 深度求索發佈DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，爲全新結構系列最小模型，具備原生多模態視覺理解。新結構旨在提升能力上限、推理速度與吞吐，並可擴展至更大參數。該模型爲552B參數MoE，採用Causal-Encoder-Decoder不對稱結構：輸入激活僅8B，輸出激活16B，HBM需求降至1/4，顯著降低成本。

items_all_raw.title: 財躍星辰聯合上海交大開源Alpha-R1：8B小模型如何顛覆資產配置？
items_all_raw.summary: 財躍星辰與上海交大安泰團隊聯合開源金融推理大模型Alpha-R1。該模型以8B參數爲基座，採用獨創語義門控推理與兩階段強化學習訓練框架，在金融推理樣本外評測中大幅領先通用大模型與傳統方法，主要面向資產配置等金融投研場景。

items_all_raw.title: 諾獎得主阿吉翁:AI時代，比以往任何時候都更需要重視手工勞動和軟技能
items_all_raw.summary: 9月10日，2026 Inclusion·外灘大會以“共創AI新經濟”開幕。諾貝爾經濟學獎得主菲利普·阿吉翁圍繞“創造性破壞”與AI革命分享稱，AI有望在未來十年使生產率增速每年額外提高約1.08個百分點，潛在影響或超IT革命；但技術潛力能否轉化爲持續增長，取決於競爭政策、教育體系和勞動力市場制度能否同步跟上。

items_all_raw.title: Marvis Windows 版本更新 最低門檻從6核16GB降到4核8GB
items_all_raw.summary: Marvis Windows新版下調最低配置至4核8GB，降低使用門檻，並新增任務通知，便於掌握執行進度。作爲系統級個人AI助手，它可搜索電腦文件與圖片，並按人像、內容主題、節日地點等維度提供AI圖片、AI文檔庫等特色能力。
